stableId.description: Stable, human-readable id, unique within its collection. Never reused after deletion.

seconds.description: Time on the source timeline in seconds (not samples).

confidence.description: Producer's own estimate; null = not estimated. Not comparable across producers.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex of SHA-256 of the file bytes. 32 hex chars (LEARN's cache key) is accepted; compare by the shorter prefix.

relPath.description: Path inside the package: forward slashes, no leading slash, no drive letter, no '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes, no control characters.

bank.description: Bank label. SP-404MKII banks are letters; the schema does not hard-code the count.

pad.description: 1..16, physical order of the SP-404MKII pad grid: 1 = bottom-left, 16 = top-right (as in LEARN's pad layout).

overridable.description: Every inferred property: `raw` = what the engine said (never overwritten by a user); `userOverride` = what a person set. Readers use userOverride ?? raw.
